say:1:1035827001:1.text: It's completely destroyed. We will record the damage and report the matter later.
say:1:1035827001:1.source_cn: 目前，它已经完全损坏。不过我们会记录和报告此事。
say:1:1035827001:1.male: It's completely destroyed. We will record the damage and report the matter later.
say:1:1035827001:1.female: It's completely destroyed. We will record the damage and report the matter later.

say:2:1035827002:1.text: This place is dangerous, after all. Perhaps one day, there will be a chance to repair it...
say:2:1035827002:1.source_cn: 这里毕竟有一个危险的东西，所以之后还是有可能修复这个传...
say:2:1035827002:1.male: This place is dangerous, after all. Perhaps one day, there will be a chance to repair it...
say:2:1035827002:1.female: This place is dangerous, after all. Perhaps one day, there will be a chance to repair it...

say:3:1035827003:1.text: The temple will learn from this to avoid similar incidents in the future.
say:3:1035827003:1.source_cn: 圣堂会吸取经验，尽可能避免再次发生类似的事。
say:3:1035827003:1.male: The temple will learn from this to avoid similar incidents in the future.
say:3:1035827003:1.female: The temple will learn from this to avoid similar incidents in the future.
